guatapeAccommodations.basicDesc: Experience the perfect blend of comfort and authentic local charm with our Cozy Essential Lodging in Guatapé. Designed for travelers who value a restful, clean sanctuary after a day of exploring the colorful zócalos and the majestic Peñol Rock, this room features a plush bed, high-speed WiFi to stay connected, and a refreshing fan to keep you cool. Start your mornings right with a delicious, locally-sourced breakfast included with your stay, and unwind in our welcoming common areas where you can share stories with fellow adventurers. Enjoy a budget-friendly escape that keeps you close to nature, culture, and unforgettable sustainable experiences.

guatapeAccommodations.deluxeDesc: Indulge in the ultimate retreat with our Deluxe Guatapé Accommodation, crafted for travelers who desire superior elegance, maximum comfort, and exclusive care. Elevate your stay with a luxurious, high-end room featuring premium furnishings, modern air conditioning, and high-speed WiFi. Delight your senses with both a delicious homemade breakfast and a gourmet lunch included daily. Step outside to unwind at our pristine swimming pool or take a short stroll to the serene nearby river. Relax in sophisticated common areas and experience an unforgettable, premium getaway designed to immerse you in the natural beauty and vibrant culture of Antioquia with total exclusivity.

guatapeActivities.activity1Desc: Embark on an unforgettable scenic boat ride across the breathtaking, island-dotted waters of the Guatapé Reservoir. Feel completely secure throughout your journey with top-tier safety equipment and comprehensive tourist insurance. Enjoy rich insights from our expert guide who explains every detail of the route and local landmarks, and elevate your aquatic adventure with optional water skiing available for an extra thrill. Discover the magic of the reservoir from a completely unique perspective!
guatapeActivities.activity1Stats: | Safety Equipment | Tourist Insurance | Expert Tour Guide | Optional Water Skiing (Extra Fee) |
guatapeActivities.activity2Desc: Experience the iconic majesty of Antioquia with our comprehensive Piedra del Peñol tour, complete with convenient roundtrip hotel transfers for a completely seamless journey. Savor a delicious included lunch and browse the vibrant nearby souvenir shops for authentic local crafts. Travel with total peace of mind thanks to comprehensive medical insurance and an expert guide who accompanies you throughout the route. Enjoy the stunning surroundings from the base or choose the optional climb up the massive monolith to take in world-class panoramic views of the reservoir.
guatapeActivities.activity2Stats: | Lunch Included | Visit Piedra del Peñol | Optional Rock Climbing | Nearby Souvenir Shops | Medical Insurance | Expert Tour Guide | Roundtrip Hotel Transfer |
guatapeActivities.activity3Desc: Immerse yourself in the colorful charm and vibrant heart of Antioquia with our guided trip to the main square of Guatapé. Wander down picturesque streets adorned with famous, artistic zócalos while an expert guide shares fascinating stories and local history. Enjoy a satisfying local lunch, a delightful snack along the way, and full tourist insurance for complete peace of mind. End your cultural journey with free time to visit authentic local souvenir shops and take home a piece of Guatapé's magic.
guatapeActivities.activity3Stats: | Lunch Included | Expert Tour Guide | Included Snack | Tourist Insurance | Souvenir Shops |

items.question: What services does BLUCO Travel offer?
items.answer: We offer eco-friendly accommodations and authentic activities in Guatapé and San Rafael, Antioquia: horseback riding, kayak, cloud forest hiking and coffee tours. We also sell handcrafted local products.

items.question: How do I book an activity or accommodation?
items.answer: You can build your plan in the Services section, add experiences to your cart and request a quote via WhatsApp at +57 318 455 9655. We reply quickly to confirm availability and dates.

items.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: We mainly work with your local currency COP (Colombian pesos). When you request your quote via WhatsApp we confirm the available payment methods for your booking.

items.question: Are the experiences guided by a local guide?
items.answer: Yes. All our activities include certified local guides who know the region and support the sustainable tourism of the Guatapé and San Rafael communities.

items.question: Where are Guatapé and San Rafael located?
items.answer: Guatapé and San Rafael are two municipalities in eastern Antioquia, Colombia, about 2 hours from Medellín, famous for their reservoir, El Peñol rock, crystal-clear waters and lush nature.

items.question: How does the positive impact get funded?
items.answer: Every booking directly supports guides, artisans and local families. We promote sustainable tourism to protect ecosystems and generate fair income in the communities we visit.
